medical_notes.in august 2021, had viral gastroenteriti: In August 2021, had viral gastroenteritis (adenovirus) and secondary leukopenia. Treated with IV ceftriaxone and supportive GI meds - Cerenia, ondansetron, kaopectalin, fluids. After resolution of lethargy, inappetence, and leukopenia, diarrhea persisted and animal would become inappetent each time cerenia and ondansetron were discontinued. Fecal cytology showed a monomorphic bacterial population of cocci suggesting dysbiosis. FMT's initiated and over 3-4 weeks he was able to wean off of all GI medications.
